profile_text.body:
Replit is a for-profit startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The company describes itself as a platform for building and deploying software collaboratively using AI, with an emphasis on eliminating setup time. Its site also promotes a feature called Intelligent Model Routing, which it claims produces the same quality output at 65% lower average cost than the previous version of its Max Mode.

Replit's primary AI product is Replit Agent, categorized as a coding and developer tool with an agentic coding capability. The platform is noted in connection with source-code exposure considerations. Replit also has a presence in the MCP registry through a server described as offering free buyer-side outcome verification and provider comparison for supplied agent receipts, listed under the name app.replit.austere-unsteady-pdf/free-agent-economy-lab.

The held facts record 161 legal exposure entries associated with California but list no specific cases or litigation at this time.
